definitions.explanation: A person who suffers harm, injury, or death as a result of a disaster, accident, crime, or war. Emphasizes the person as someone who was sacrificed or harmed by circumstances beyond their control.

examples.japanese: {犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of victims is rising.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The death toll from the earthquake exceeded one hundred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{黙祷|もくとう}→黙祷：17408_mokutou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捧|ささ}げた→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧。
examples.english: We observed a moment of silence for the victims of war.

notes: Common collocations: {犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (casualties occur), {犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to produce casualties), {犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冥福|めいふく}→冥福：16396_meifuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧ (to pray for the repose of the victims). The base word ⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧ means "sacrifice" and can be used without ～⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: ⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to fall victim, to be sacrificed). Related: ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧ (victim — legal term, emphasizes having suffered damage), ⟦{被災者|ひさいしゃ}→被災者：25337_hisaisha⟧ (disaster victim — specifically those affected by a natural disaster).
